declarations.name: divergence_extension_eq
declarations.statement:
theorem divergence_extension_eq (X : Set E) (ψ φ : E → ℝ)
    (hEq : EqOn ψ φ X) (a b : E) (ha : a ∈ X) (hb : b ∈ interior X) :
    divergence ψ a b = divergence φ a b

declarations.name: advance
declarations.statement:
def advance (V : Set E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℝ) (f : E → EReal) (x : E) : Option E := by
  classical
  exact if h : ∃ p, p ∈ V ∧
      IsMinOn (fun z => f z + ((η⁻¹ * divergence ψ z x : ℝ) : EReal)) V p
    then some (Classical.choose h) else none

declarations.name: iterate
declarations.statement:
def iterate (V : Set E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℕ → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 : E) : ℕ → Option E
  | 0 => some x0
  | t + 1 => (iterate V ψ η loss x0 t).bind (advance V ψ (η t) (loss t))

declarations.name: advance_some_spec
declarations.statement:
theorem advance_some_spec (V : Set E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℝ)
    (f : E → EReal) (x p : E) (h : advance V ψ η f x = some p) :
    p ∈ V ∧ IsMinOn (fun z => f z + ((η⁻¹ * divergence ψ z x : ℝ) : EReal)) V p

declarations.name: advance_none_iff
declarations.statement:
theorem advance_none_iff (V : Set E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℝ)
    (f : E → EReal) (x : E) :
    advance V ψ η f x = none ↔ ¬ ∃ p, p ∈ V ∧
      IsMinOn (fun z => f z + ((η⁻¹ * divergence ψ z x : ℝ) : EReal)) V p

declarations.name: iterate_prefix
declarations.statement:
theorem iterate_prefix (V : Set E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (η η' : ℕ → ℝ)
    (loss loss' : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 : E) (t : ℕ)
    (hη : ∀ s < t, η s = η' s) (hloss : ∀ s < t, loss s = loss' s) :
    iterate V ψ η loss x0 t = iterate V ψ η' loss' x0 t

declarations.name: iterate_succ_some_spec
declarations.statement:
theorem iterate_succ_some_spec (V : Set E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℕ → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 p : E) (t : ℕ)
    (h : iterate V ψ η loss x0 (t + 1) = some p) :
    ∃ x, iterate V ψ η loss x0 t = some x ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      IsMinOn (fun z => loss t z + (((η t)⁻¹ * divergence ψ z x : ℝ) : EReal)) V p

declarations.name: iterate_no_recovery
declarations.statement:
theorem iterate_no_recovery (V : Set E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℕ → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 : E) (t k : ℕ)
    (h : iterate V ψ η loss x0 t = none) :
    iterate V ψ η loss x0 (t + k) = none

declarations.name: iterate_complete_of_step_attained
declarations.statement:
theorem iterate_complete_of_step_attained (V : Set E) (ψ : E → ℝ) (η : ℕ → ℝ)
    (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 : E) (T : ℕ)
    (hatt : ∀ t < T, ∀ x, iterate V ψ η loss x0 t = some x →
      ∃ p, p ∈ V ∧
        IsMinOn (fun z => loss t z + (((η t)⁻¹ * divergence ψ z x : ℝ) : EReal)) V p) :
    ∃ p, iterate V ψ η loss x0 T = some p

declarations.name: iterate_one_step
declarations.context: variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
declarations.statement:
theorem iterate_one_step (V : Set E) (hV : Convex ℝ V) (ψ : E → ℝ)
    (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 x p : E) (t : ℕ)
    (hx : iterate V ψ η loss x0 t = some x)
    (hp : iterate V ψ η loss x0 (t + 1) = some p)
    (hη : 0 < η t) (hf : BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceProper (loss t))
    (hs : ∀ z ∈ V, (BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceSubdifferential (loss t) z).Nonempty)
    (hdx : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x) (hdp : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ p) :
    ∀ u ∈ V, η t * ((loss t p).toReal - (loss t u).toReal) ≤
      divergence ψ u x - divergence ψ u p - divergence ψ p x

declarations.name: closed_strict_regularizer_missing_minimum
declarations.statement:
theorem closed_strict_regularizer_missing_minimum :
    let V : Set ℝ := Iic 0
    let f : ℝ → EReal := fun z => (z : EReal)
    let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := Real.exp
    V.Nonempty ∧ IsClosed V ∧ Convex ℝ V ∧ (0 : ℝ) ∈ V ∧
      SourceProper f ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, (SourceSubdifferential f z).Nonempty) ∧
      SourceClosed (fun z => ((ψ z : ℝ) : EReal)) ∧
      StrictConvexOn ℝ univ ψ ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z) ∧
      (0 : ℝ) ∈ interior (univ : Set ℝ) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, f z + ((divergence ψ z 0 : ℝ) : EReal) = ((Real.exp z - 1 : ℝ) : EReal)) ∧
      (¬ ∃ p, p ∈ V ∧ IsMinOn (fun z => f z + ((divergence ψ z 0 : ℝ) : EReal)) V p) ∧
      advance V ψ 1 f 0 = none ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, iterate V ψ (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => f) 0 (k + 1) = none)

declarations.name: interior_extension_boundary_difference
declarations.statement:
theorem interior_extension_boundary_difference :
    let X : Set ℝ := Ici 0
    let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => z ^ 2 + z
    let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => z ^ 2 + |z|
    EqOn ψ φ X ∧ ψ (-1) ≠ φ (-1) ∧ (1 : ℝ) ∈ interior X ∧ (2 : ℝ) ∈ X ∧
      divergence ψ 2 1 = divergence φ 2 1 ∧ divergence ψ 2 1 = 1 ∧
      divergence ψ 2 0 = 4 ∧ divergence φ 2 0 = 6 ∧ ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ φ 0

declarations.name: two_distinct_current_losses
declarations.statement:
theorem two_distinct_current_losses :
    let V : Set ℝ := Icc (-1) 1
    let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => z ^ 4 / 4 + z ^ 2 / 2
    let f0 : ℝ → EReal := fun z => if z ∈ V then ((|z| : ℝ) : EReal) else ⊤
    let f1 : ℝ → EReal := fun z => if z ∈ V then ((-5 * z / 8 : ℝ) : EReal) else ⊤
    let loss : ℕ → ℝ → EReal := fun t => if t = 0 then f0 else f1
    SourceProper f0 ∧ SourceProper f1 ∧
      (∀ z ∈ V, (SourceSubdifferential f0 z).Nonempty) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ V, (SourceSubdifferential f1 z).Nonempty) ∧
      StrictConvexOn ℝ univ ψ ∧
      ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (abs : ℝ → ℝ) 0 ∧
      f0 2 = ⊤ ∧ f1 2 = ⊤ ∧
      iterate V ψ (fun _ => 1) loss (1 / 2) 0 = some (1 / 2) ∧
      iterate V ψ (fun _ => 1) loss (1 / 2) 1 = some 0 ∧
      iterate V ψ (fun _ => 1) loss (1 / 2) 2 = some (1 / 2) ∧
      (∀ (η' : ℕ → ℝ) (loss' : ℕ → ℝ → EReal),
        η' 0 = 1 → η' 1 = 1 → loss' 0 = f0 → loss' 1 = f1 →
        iterate V ψ η' loss' (1 / 2) 2 = some (1 / 2)) ∧
      divergence ψ 0 (1 / 2) = 11 / 64 ∧
      divergence ψ (1 / 2) 0 = 9 / 64 ∧
      (∀ u ∈ V, ((f0 0).toReal - (f0 u).toReal) +
        ((f1 (1 / 2)).toReal - (f1 u).toReal) ≤
        divergence ψ u (1 / 2) - divergence ψ u (1 / 2) -
          divergence ψ 0 (1 / 2) - divergence ψ (1 / 2) 0) ∧
      (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ -5 / 16

declarations.name: boundary_outside_center_run
declarations.statement:
theorem boundary_outside_center_run :
    let V : Set ℝ := Icc 0 1
    let f : ℝ → EReal := fun z => if z ∈ V then (z : EReal) else ⊤
    let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => z ^ 2 / 2
    SourceProper f ∧
      (∀ z ∈ V, (SourceSubdifferential f z).Nonempty) ∧
      StrictConvexOn ℝ univ ψ ∧ f (-1) = ⊤ ∧ (-1 : ℝ) ∉ V ∧
      iterate V ψ (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => f) (-1) 1 = some 0 ∧
      divergence ψ 0 (-1) = 1 / 2 ∧
      (∀ u ∈ V, -u ≤ divergence ψ u (-1) - divergence ψ u 0 - divergence ψ 0 (-1)) ∧
      (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2
